title: 4‑BR 30A Vacation Home with Beach Access & Communal Pool
meta_description: Experience Ocean Park, a 4-BR, 4.5-bath 30A vacation home in SeaNest Village with a communal pool and beach access. Accommodates 12 guests.
description_expanded: Ocean Park seems fitting when the front door leads to the ocean and the back to a state park. This beautifully designed and quality constructed home is located in SeaNest Village and backs up to a protected State forest offering privacy, walking trails and beautiful views. Ocean Park is only a 4-minute walk to deeded beach access! The stunning neighborhood pool and sunset viewing tower are just a 1-minute walk away.The 1st level of the home offers a cozy seating area as well as 2 bedrooms. The 2nd floor of the home includes the stunning main open concept area. The large kitchen island features a great line of sight to the dining table and entertaining area, as well as beautiful forest views. There's plenty of room to spread out and create some fabulous meals. The chef in your group will love the large gas range with double ovens. On the 2nd floor you'll also find a half bathroom, laundry room and a bedroom suite. The 4th bedroom is upstairs on the 3rd level plus a sleeping alcove.At the end of your beach or pool day, make sure to take advantage of the commercial outdoor grill outside the kitchen. Then head downstairs and enjoy some s'mores at the front of the home with the fire pit.The owners of Ocean Park have also provided beach chairs and a wagon that can be found in the garage. Pack your snacks and grab your beach towel and you'll have your toes in the sand in no time.Need more space? You can also rent this home together with its next door neighbor, Sea Echo. Just give us a call!Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 121st Floor, Bedroom 1: Bunkroom with full-over-full bunk, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo1st Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub and large shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV and private balcony. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub and large shower.3rd Floor, Landing: 2 twin beds.Beach Access:Exit out the neighborhood to 30A and cross the street to the bike path. Walk towards the right and you will see the gate at Sea Turtle Dr for your deeded beach access, utilizing the one security fob provided at the home.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 4 minutes walkingSeaNest Village:SeaNest Village is an exclusive, gated community in beautiful Seagrove Beach across from where Eastern Lake Road and Scenic 30A meet. The community includes an incredible duel tiered modern luxury pool with an infinity edge. The pool area has abundant deck space, a community grill and a tower sitting area for taking in the Gulf breezes and 30A sunsets. The northern side off the neighborhood backs up to Point Washington State forest where you can hike on the nature trails and boardwalks thru the Cypress forest.Your stay at Ocean Park comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars in driveway with passes; parking for additional 2 cars in garage.* Benchmark cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities* Please note, there is ongoing construction in this neighborhoodAn initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
